# Cooling acceptance checklist

Before expanding the Borealis pilot:

- [ ] Record at least 1,200 requests.
- [ ] Verify median latency at most 42 ms.
- [ ] Verify p95 latency at most 80 ms for the acceptance window.
- [ ] Ask the release owner to approve the next phase.

Decision evidence: {{source:decision}}. Measurement evidence: {{source:audit}}.
